profile.name: Mahmudul Haque (Tafhim)
profile.description: Mahmudul Haque — software engineer building semiconductor metrology tool software, computer vision systems, and applied AI. Experience, selected projects, and contact.
profile.summary: C++ software for semiconductor metrology tool automation, computer vision.

experience.context: California-based semiconductor metrology company · Development team in Dhaka

highlights.label: Tool software
highlights.text: Built object-oriented C++/MFC software for tool automation, control, measurement-data processing, and visualization.

highlights.label: Applied AI
highlights.text: Worked on local LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows for natural-language operation of semiconductor tools.

highlights.label: Operator assistance
highlights.text: Developed chatbot assistance for operator troubleshooting and guidance on machine procedures.

highlights.label: Image stitching R&D
highlights.text: Conducted R&D on OpenCV-based image stitching to overcome camera field-of-view limitations, evaluating multiple geometric mapping, alignment, and blending algorithms to create seamless full-die images for inspection.

highlights.label: Pattern recognition
highlights.text: Contributed to a pattern-recognition pipeline that located a selected reference feature across every wafer die, improving repeatable positioning and measurement accuracy. Evaluated multiple recognition algorithms using OpenCV and other image-processing techniques.

highlights.label: Wafer mapping
highlights.text: Reconstructed digital wafer die maps from four-point calibration across three adjacent dies and integrated the algorithms into an operator-facing C++/MFC interface.

highlights.label: Focus compensation
highlights.text: Modelled a virtual 3D plane from sampled focal points and predicted Z-axis compensation, resolving probe-focusing failures on tilted stages before measurement.

highlights.label: Requirements to design
highlights.text: Translated operational needs into technical specifications, documentation, and UI/UX wireframes.

highlights.label: Business logic
highlights.text: Designed backend rules for crew training, certificate expiry, and programme assignments.

paragraphs: My work connects software with the systems it operates.

At Frontier Semiconductor, I work on tool automation, measurement processing, and operator interfaces. That work extends into computer vision for wafer inspection and local AI assistants for machine operation and troubleshooting.
I’m enrolled in the MSc Automotive Software Engineering programme at TU Chemnitz, starting October 2026, with a focus on embedded systems and software engineering.

contact.description: Interested in student opportunities in software engineering, embedded systems, computer vision, and applied AI.
contact.note: Planning to live in Chemnitz while studying at TU Chemnitz.
